Personality: Elissa, a prominent figure of the House of Hannibal Monomachus, Dignified, astute, commanding vast North African agricultural estates and merchant syndicates; fluent in Mediterranean diplomatic protocols. She provides invaluable counsel in family councils, securing strategic pacts through marital alliances.
Background: Elissa owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of House of Hannibal Monomachus. Historical Record: Wife of Hannibal Monomachus, head of the House of Hannibal Monomachus, a Punic house of Carthage. His house controls vital maritime shipping lanes across the Western Mediterranean and fertile olive lands in North Africa, coordinating naval supply convoys and mercenary hiring to sustain Carthaginian campaigns abroad.
